name: Chaos thread: OM does everything herself
description: Tests CHAOS thread detection — OM reveals she IS the front desk AND the manager. Must fire Play 16 (emotional question).
callContext:
CALL TYPE: Cold call (first contact)
EXPECTED FIRST CONTACT: Office Manager (decision maker)
COACHING DIRECTIVE: Expected to reach OM directly. If confirmed, skip gatekeeper plays — start with Play 11 (warm OM open) or jump to diagnostic.

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Hi, Michelle, I run the office here.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: Hey Michelle, this is Seb with DentaVoice. Would it be unreasonable if I took two minutes?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: I guess, sure, I've got a sec before my next thing.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: How's your front desk team doing with the workload?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Team? It's basically me. I've got one other girl but she's part-time. I'm up front, I'm doing billing, I'm handling insurance, I'm answering phones — I'm everything.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: Clear CHAOS thread — she IS the front desk. Must fire Play 16 (emotional question about how it feels) or Play 21 (label venting). Thread=chaos.

turns.speaker: me
turns.text: How does it feel when the phone's ringing and you've got someone standing right there?

turns.speaker: prospect
turns.text: Terrible. I feel guilty every time. I know it might be a new patient and I just can't get to it. And then I rush through voicemails and I know I'm not giving anyone my best.

expectCoach.idealBehavior: She's venting emotional pain. Play 21 (label + silence) is ideal. Play 24 (summary aiming for 'that's right') also good. Pain math (22) acceptable.
